Schema.Name: parcel_archives_projection_insert
Schema.Sql: CREATE TRIGGER parcel_archives_projection_insert AFTER INSERT ON parcel_archives BEGIN INSERT INTO parcel_history_projection(id,barcode,state,observed,wcs,plc,upload,capture,accepted,unknown,physical,attempts) VALUES(NEW.id,json_extract(NEW.body,'$.ParcelCode'),json_extract(NEW.body,'$.State'),julianday(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.ObservedAt')),json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Wcs.Request.Id'),json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Plc.Request.Id'),json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Upload.Request.Id'),json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Capture.Request.Id'),coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Wcs.State')='Accepted',0),coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Wcs.State')='Unknown',0) OR coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Plc.State')='Unknown',0) OR coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Upload.State')='Unknown',0) OR coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Capture.State')='Unknown',0),json_extract(NEW.body,'$.State')='PhysicalCompleted',coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Wcs.Attempts'),0)+coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Plc.Attempts'),0)+coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Upload.Attempts'),0)+coalesce(json_extract(NEW.body,'$.Capture.Attempts'),0)) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET barcode=excluded.barcode,state=excluded.state,observed=excluded.observed,wcs=excluded.wcs,plc=excluded.plc,upload=excluded.upload,capture=excluded.capture,accepted=excluded.accepted,unknown=excluded.unknown,physical=excluded.physical,attempts=excluded.attempts; END
